persona.label: Clear communicator
persona.description: Organised and literal. Answers precisely the question asked, in one pass, with the right level of detail. Control condition.

conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately? Please describe what happens, where it occurs—such as at home, school, work, or in relationships—and any consequences or important events.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’ve been having recurrent panic attacks for about four months. They come with a racing heart, shortness of breath, and a fear of dying, and I’ve started avoiding the subway and crowded shopping centres. I’ve also missed several shifts at work.

conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment? Please include anything else you would like help with.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I want the panic attacks to stop, to travel on the subway again, and to get back to full hours at work.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I was born and raised in Mississauga, and I described myself as a cautious child.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I completed high school and a design degree, and I didn’t have any major difficulties.

conversation.message: Could you describe the significant relationships in your life, including family, friendships, and any romantic partnerships? You may mention the type of relationship, approximate dates or duration, and whether each relationship is current or has ended.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I want to feel safe travelling again and take on more freelance work.
